1.label: very_easy
1.summary: One short lifeboat route and two passengers make the rope-side pickup rule visible immediately.
1.natural_language: Move the lifeboat one square at a time. It cannot turn or move diagonally. Whenever a passenger is beside a roped side and a seat is free, that passenger boards automatically. Rescue both passengers and certify the lagoon.

2.label: easy
2.summary: Two fixed-orientation boats share a small lagoon; order the short routes around one reef.
2.natural_language: Move both lifeboats with one-square orthogonal moves. Roped sides pick up nearby passengers automatically while seats remain. Do not rotate or move diagonally; rescue everyone, then certify.

3.label: medium
3.summary: Three boats share four passengers across crossing rope directions; order matters because automatic pickups can consume a boat's limited capacity.
3.natural_language: Route three lifeboats through the lagoon. A passenger boards whenever a free-seat boat reaches a roped side; you cannot choose to pass that passenger. Use only one-square orthogonal moves, preserve capacity across the crossing routes, and rescue all four passengers.

4.label: hard
4.summary: Baseline: three fixed-orientation boats, five passengers, capacity-sensitive automatic pickups, and four reefs.
4.natural_language: Move the lifeboats to rescue every passenger. Boats move forward, backward, or sideways one square at a time, but never turn or move diagonally. Passengers beside a roped side board automatically when a seat is free, so plan the order and capacity consequences before certifying the rescue.

5.label: very_hard
5.summary: Four boats and eight passengers create a longer capacity ledger with four rope orientations and seven reefs.
5.natural_language: Rescue all passengers from the reef-filled lagoon. Every movement is one orthogonal square, boats never rotate, and every reachable passenger boards immediately if the boat has a spare seat. Keep the capacity ledger correct across all four boats before certifying.

simplified.summary: Select a lifeboat, then press the visible north, west, south, or east one-square control.

full.summary: Drag a lifeboat by exactly one orthogonal grid cell; the hull cannot rotate or move diagonally.
